entries.title: An argument operator scopes over a whole argument sequence rather than only its nearest value

source_evidence.quote:
Die vier bisherigen Einwortwerte bleiben kurz:

```text
Y     POSTEN
AIIN  WERT
AIN   ANTEIL
OR    EINHEIT
```

Neu ist nicht ein längeres Wörterbuch, sondern ihre gemeinsame Grammatik.
Unter den1,656 Zustandskarten tragen382 Karten insgesamt390 dieser
Argumentstellen. Alle fallen in nur sechs sichtbare `OT/OL/DY`-Hüllen und alle
erhalten eine kompositionelle Standardlesung.

| Hülle | Stellen | kurze Lesung |
|---|---:|---|
| `OT>A<END` | 185 | `DANACH · ARG` |
| `OL>A<END` | 156 | `FORTSETZEN · ARG` |
| `START>A<DY` | 31 | `ARG · ABSCHLIESSEN` |
| `START>A<OL` | 16 | `ARG · FORTSETZEN` |
| `OT>A<OL` | 1 | `DANACH · ARG · FORTSETZEN` |
| `OL>A<OL` | 1 | `FORTSETZEN · ARG · FORTSETZEN` |

entries.assessment: Not a duplicate: it compares explicit multi-argument broad scope with nearest attachment; IDEA000038 concerns omitted-carrier reuse. Still untestable from the cited source because the GDT559 passage reports renderer-assigned compositional readings and no independent scope boundary/argument endpoint. The falsifier OR “both models make identical predictions” is non-identifiability, not an empirical failure.
entries.reopening_note: No empirical falsifier currently available; require independently bound scope boundaries and argument effects before testing.

entries.title: An explicit restriction changes applicability while an implicit default preserves it

source_evidence.quote:
Damit ist ein Stamm weiterhin nur ein kurzer Wert. Eine längere Form wie
`OT+AIIN` bedeutet nicht, dass AIIN nun „den nächsten Wert als Träger eröffnen“
heißen muss. Sie setzt sich aus `OT=DANACH/ERÖFFNEN` und `AIIN=WERT` zusammen.

entries.assessment: Not a duplicate: it narrows conditional applicability/prohibition to overt restriction versus unmarked default. The cited GDT559 sentence only decomposes OT+AIIN; it does not identify a restriction cue or applicability endpoint. Treat the OR missing-binding clause as unavailable design, not a falsification.
entries.reopening_note: No empirical falsifier currently available; require independently marked restriction and independently observed applicability/licensing.

entries.title: A quality expression selects a local comparison standard rather than an absolute degree

source_evidence.quote:
GDT626 found a bounded four-cell ending but could only call it “value I–IV.”
GDT627 supplies the missing head semantics. The same written slot is reused
productively:

```text
quality head + a + value  = quality in degree I/II/III/IV
d            + a + value  = free measure or grade I/II/III/IV
```

In a plant-part list, the practical default for the second construction is a
local amount or dose. Thus `daiin` no longer means a generic operation and no
longer remains the opaque “d-value III.” It reads **three local measures or
portions**, with the kind of unit still open.

entries.assessment: Not a duplicate: it asks baseline-sensitive comparison versus invariant degree, while IDEA000023 asks adjacent modifier scope. The GDT627 quote supplies value/measure working readings but no independently bound baseline/property contrast. Invariance without such a bound baseline is not an empirical falsifier.
entries.reopening_note: No empirical falsifier currently available; require independently bound baseline, property and held value spans.

entries.title: A measured value is calibrated by its local unit rather than being a portable ordinal

source_evidence.quote:
GDT626 found a bounded four-cell ending but could only call it “value I–IV.”
GDT627 supplies the missing head semantics. The same written slot is reused
productively:

```text
quality head + a + value  = quality in degree I/II/III/IV
d            + a + value  = free measure or grade I/II/III/IV
```

In a plant-part list, the practical default for the second construction is a
local amount or dose. Thus `daiin` no longer means a generic operation and no
longer remains the opaque “d-value III.” It reads **three local measures or
portions**, with the kind of unit still open.

entries.assessment: Not a duplicate: it asks unit-dependent calibration/ratios versus portable ordinal rank, whereas IDEA000014 tests amount-frame conservation and IDEA000021 unit recurrence. It remains untestable: no independently bound units or conversion/ratio endpoint is supplied. “No unit contrast can be bound” is a design stop, not evidence for ordinal meaning.
entries.reopening_note: No empirical falsifier currently available; require independently bound differing units and a predeclared conversion/rank endpoint.

conclusion: All four are retained as raw proposals. None is an actual duplicate of the cited existing idea; each is a related specialization. None currently has an empirical falsifier because the required semantic endpoint is explicitly availability_unknown. Missing independent binding is a stop condition, not a negative result. No proposal is promoted or added here.
